title: Anthony Bourdain's Favorite Fried Mortadella & Provolone Sandwich
originalTitle: Anthony Bourdain's Favorite Fried Mortadella & Provolone Sandwich
ingredients: 1 crusty Kaiser roll, Portuguese roll, or sourdough bun
6 oz thinly sliced pistachio mortadella, divided into 3 ribbons/piles
1 tsp butter & freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat and arrange the thinly sliced mortadella in 3 ruffled stacks so the edges crisp and blister in their own rendered fat.
Flip each ruffled pile of mortadella and top each with a slice of provolone cheese, adding a splash of water and covering for 30 seconds until melted.
Spread mayonnaise on one half of the roll and Dijon mustard on the other. Stack all three cheesy mortadella mounds onto the roll.
Place the assembled sandwich back into the hot skillet, pressing down lightly so the bread toasts and soaks up the savory mortadella juices.
notes: Doc Note: Portuguese roll, provolone, mortadella. Dijon one side, mayo/provolone other. Fry mortadella 3 stacks, melt provolone 3 slices on it, stack them on sandwich, fry sandwich slightly push down in pan soak up mortadella juices.
